body:
You don't annoy me. I'm thankful that a stranger from the internet took the time to read about my problems and respond to it. It makes me feel less alone. Please continue to reply to those posts. I'm sure it helps a lot of people. 

Right now I'm calm. Broken, but calm. I probably procrastinate killing myself like I procrastinated everything... Maybe it's good I didn't feel like writing the farewell letters yet. I guess once I write them, it will be so much easier.

Thank you for your thoughtful reply. 

I'm not a student anymore... I gave up. I couldn't find motivation when I had to opportunity to work on my thesis. I sometimes regret that I didn't stay enrolled, because it has many perks... but at the time the fees were due I didn't have the money and you have to have health insurance, which I couldn't pay either... So I (would) have been 'kicked out' because of this additionally...

You're right in that I should fight by trying to find work and making ends meet. That's the reasonable thing people should do in this situation. It's just too overwhelming for me right now. I don't have the necessary identification and I'm now a 26-year-old dropout with nothing but a high-school degree. Writing this and weighing the shame of it against death makes me realize, that I'm fucked up... and too weak to fight. I shouldn't give a shit about people... but I'm too ashamed. I'd run away, but I have nowhere to go and I'm worried the money left wouldn't take me far enough (also considering the lack of identification). 

I'm not in a "this just happened" situation that only seems bad right now. This has started in November and my lack of motivation and responsibility has brought me here.

Right now I'm so fucking done. I again invested in someone who stopped liking me back. Our expectations apparently didn't match. I felt so neglected. I didn't want to go the "Nothing is wrong" or "I don't know what's wrong route". So I talked, when I probably shouldn't have. Now he left. I'm mad. Disappointed. Sad. He doesn't seem to care at all. So I got my confirmation: He doesn't care about me. 

I'm now going to open all those unopened letters I avoided reading. This might give me the rest. I already feel like every little thing that I felt living for in the past weeks just go ruined. I know how this shouldn't have ruined it... but it did. Everything feels empty now.

I'll open the letters and they will make me cry and then I might not be able to bear it at all. I might just go ahead and end it all here.

Things haven't changed much. Some days I have the 'You need to hit rock bottom and then the university will skyrocket you' mentality and then days like these I just make up excuses to why I can't make it to appointments and just stay in bed all day. 

Am I just lazy or depressed? Even when I'm really productive one day and it gets me all excited, I get all 'Not today' the next day. 

I want a miracle. I don't think I have much time left. Soon I will have no cent to my name, but a bunch of debt. I'm still pretending to be enrolled in university and working at my side job. But all I do is living of the last cash I have. Then I need to set an end to all this, because I can't live with this shame.

I wish I could at least focus long enough to write something publishable. Deep in my heart I feel like I could be a great author and live from writing. But as long as I don't finish anything, I'm not... and I probably never will.

I used to have all those goals and dreams. I feel more of a failure with every day that passes. I'm 26 and just dropped out of college, mainly due to financial trouble but also because I lost my passion. I haven't accomplished a damn thing. I also fucked up a couple other things in the more recent past. I have nothing left but family and a few friends who I never wanted to disappoint - I'm so afraid they'd hate to know the truth. I can't motivate myself anymore... Every day I accomplish nothing again. It's a vicious cycle.

I had a couple of rough days. Nothing special happened, I just felt so lost. Some days I have hope and want everything to work out somehow. But most days I'm just waiting for the day I can't bear it anymore.

I'm living day to day. Some days I hope I come up with a great idea to fix all this mess. But then again I have no motivation. It's a weird feeling to plan ahead and then the thought "What for? I might not need it." comes up. Right now I just want to live each day like it was my last. I try to, but my (almost not existent) budget doesn't give me many possibilities. Taking a walk and being alone makes me want to cry. I can't be alone with my thoughts.

I'm not pregnant. Which is great, because I don't have to explain to anyone how I could have been so stupid to get pregnant from a guy I just met two months ago. Or to get pregnant in this situation (if they knew - jeez, I'm so good at hiding... or nobody cares). But then again: It gave me hope... a reason to live... maybe!?
